title: Go-live chrono: KPI sprintplay and decision anchors
content:
Purpose: lightweight sprint-driven play for the 0->1 go-live window focused on measurable KPIs, quick decision anchors, and minimal staffing heuristics. This doc is intentionally compact so on-call, PMs, and ops leads can scan and act.

Context: we are planning a staged rollout for the Hosted API feature set (model catalog + streaming) with a small pilot of 5k DAU followed by phased expansion. Past launches got stuck on ambiguous rollback triggers; this artifact centralizes the measurable anchors and the chrono (day-by-day cadence) for the first 72 hours and the 14-day stabilization sprint.

Top-level goals (linked to OKRs):
- Reduce mean request latency for text-generation to <= 180ms p50 and <= 600ms p95 for pilot traffic.
- Keep error-rate (5xx + model timeouts) under 0.8% during pilot.
- No >20% token-cost regression vs baseline model stack.
- Achievement measured by automated dashboards and daily ops readout.

Primary KPIs (definition, owner, target):
- p50 latency (api/generate) | owner: infra-telemetry | target: <= 180ms | query: telemetry.query("api.generate.p50", env=pilot)
- p95 latency (api/generate) | owner: infra-telemetry | target: <= 600ms
- 5xx rate (api) | owner: sre | target: < 0.8%
- model-timeout-rate | owner: serving-runtime | target: < 0.5%
- token-cost-per-req (normalized) | owner: product-ops | target: <= 1.2x baseline
- quality-regression (prompt set A) | owner: applied-ml | target: human-review fail rate <= 3%

Day 0 (UTC): Canary gating and smoke checks (hours relative to start)
- H-6: final gating checklist (deploy tag, infra probes green, canary config reviewed). Owners: deploy-eng, infra.
- H-1: validate synthetic traffic for 10 minutes at pilot qps. Run quick regression eval on prompt set A (sanity). If quality-regression > 5% -> abort and rollback.
- 0h: Small canary (1% of pilot QPS -> ~50rps) for 30 minutes. Monitor p50/p95 and 5xx. If p95 > 2x baseline or 5xx > 2x baseline -> stop rollout and investigate.

First 72 hours (chronology & ops cadence):
- 0-6h: rapid feedback loop. Ops check-ins every 30 min. Triage channel: #launch-pilot (pinned runbook). Escalation: oncall-sre -> infra lead.
- 6-24h: expand to 10% of pilot qps if all KPIs within targets. Ops check-ins hourly. Run token-cost sampling job every 2h.
- 24-48h: expand to 50% of pilot qps if stability holds. Daily executive summary at 30h.
- 48-72h: full pilot traffic (~100% pilot). Daily postmortem-ready notes prepared.

Decision anchors (heuristic matrix):
- GREEN: all KPIs within targets for two consecutive measurement windows -> continue expansion.
- YELLOW: any KPI outside target by <= 1.5x or transient blip (<10 mins) -> hold expansion, trigger mitigations (burst autoscale, switch to fallback model variant, reduce batch size).
- RED: p95 > 2x target for >15 minutes OR 5xx > 1.5% sustained for 30 minutes OR quality-regression > 5% -> immediate rollback to previous stable model version and suspend rollout.

Rollback checklist (if RED):
1) Pause external traffic routing to canary pool (network/traffic owner).
2) Switch inference runtime to previous model tag (serving-runtime lead).
3) Notify stakeholders (PM, Eng leads, SRE) via #launch-pilot and email escalation list.
4) Open incident ticket and set P0 on-call.
5) Collect artifacts: telemetry snapshot (last 60m), last 100 failed requests, model logs, gateway traces.

Staffing heuristics (minimal on-call roster for first 72h):
- Day shift (08:00-20:00 local): 1 SRE on primary, 1 infra engineer, 1 serving-runtime engineer, 1 product-ops owner, 1 applied-ml on-call (floating).
- Night shift (20:00-08:00): 1 SRE, 1 infra on-call, product-ops on-call (reduced cadence).
- Escalation ladder: SRE -> infra lead -> exec on-call.
- If RED triggered: bring in serving-runtime and model-owner within 30 minutes.

Quick mitigations (playbook snippets):
- Latency spike: 1) decrease batch size on affected pool, 2) enable prefix cache on edge, 3) route new traffic to lower-capacity but faster model variant.
- Error spike: 1) scale up GPU pool, 2) temporarily increase timeout thresholds to prevent client-facing 5xx while investigating, 3) disable noncritical telemetry to reduce load.
- Quality regression: roll to previous model version; open ML investigation and freeze config changes until root cause identified.

14-day stabilization sprint (post-pilot):
- Day 1-3: stabilize baseline KPIs, tag and snapshot telemetry baselines.
- Day 4-7: focused cost optimization experiments (quantization profiles, batching policy tuning) with safety gates.
- Day 8-14: run regression evals, build canary-runbook for next larger rollout, and finalize runbook into Confluence (link in linked_artifacts).

Instrumentation & dashboard checklist (must be runnable pre-roll):
- Live dashboard: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, model-timeout-rate, token-cost-per-req, queued-requests. Owner: infra-telemetry.
- Alerting: Pager alert for 5xx > 1.5% sustained 10m, p95 > 2x baseline sustained 15m, model-timeout-rate > 1% 10m. Owner: SRE.
- Sampling: automated capture of 1% of requests including inputs/outputs + model logits for offline quality checks. Owner: applied-ml.

Open questions for next sync (ops sync 2025-02-19):
- Do we need a separate pilot cluster for EU region? (affects staffing and telemetry ownership)
- Acceptable cost increase ceiling during first 72h for commercial teams? Proposed: 1.3x baseline, needs PM signoff.
- Finalize list of fallback model variants and compatibility matrix (serving-runtime to prepare).

Immediate next steps (owner -> action):
- Maya (product-ops): finalize executive one-pager and send calendar invites for 72h coverage shifts.
- Ethan (infra-telemetry): deploy pilot dashboard and verify alerts by 2025-02-17 EOD (blocker if incomplete).
- Lina (serving-runtime): prepare rollback scripts and validate automated model rollbacks in staging (PROJ-2201).

Notes to self / rough todos: keep checklist short, prefer automation over manual steps. Avoid ambiguous "investigate" without rollback anchors. When in doubt, set the stage to HOLD and consult infra lead.

Appendix: Short-command runbook snippets (for chatops integration)
- /rollout pause -> routes 0% to canary; requires approver=infra-lead.
- /rollout resume -> resume prior percentage; must be called from approved list.
- /rollback model <tag> -> triggers model switch and post-deploy smoke.

This doc is a working artifact; please add comments inline or propose edits in the next ops sync.
